correctness.rationale: Explicit bijective ant update and inverse on 4,194,304 states; direct full permutation traversal counts exactly 46,976 cycles, and separate preimage/indegree checker validates every state and reproduces all 25 rows. No incomplete sample, infinite-size inference or external certification is used.

value.rationale: The 4-by-4 grid is the first even-by-even nondegenerate square torus, with distinct left/right and up/down neighbors, directly testing known even-even parity restrictions. A natural complete finite orbit classification yields the stronger site-specific factor-16 restriction, a rich 25-period spectrum and exactly two inequivalent maximal 512-step orbit types. It serves as an exact benchmark for the dynamics and geometric symmetry reduction, without inventing downstream theorems.
